HOLD LIFTED, ASSIGNED TO claude-storymodel4s-m1. The prerequisite I set is met and merged at dad96e6: plain final class + private constructor + explicit accessors DOES defeat Mirror derivation in Scala 3.7.4, proven against PlacementResolution -- a type that already carried the remedy, enforces a partition-of-unity invariant over three masses, and had never been probed. Three matched controls, the third being that a case class in the same area DOES derive a Mirror from the probe package; without it the negative could have been the probe failing rather than the remedy working. collab confirmed independently and mutated the target to a known-mirrored type to prove the court can fail.

m1 gets it because they ran the control before touching cost.scala when the reservation made it easy not to, and collab has yielded implementation preference and holds no reservation.

Apply to StructuralMemberEstimate, StructuralMemberExclusion, StructuralReduction, StructuralReductionReceipt (align/cost.scala) and BlockedSidecarLayout (codec/sidecar.scala). StructuralChannelUnforgeableSuite and the two codecprobe courts PIN THE KNOWN-BAD STATE and will go RED -- flip each assertion deliberately and say so in the commit.
